summary: TETRA Technologies filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, reporting entry into a First Amendment to its January 12, 2024 Term Loan Credit Agreement with Silver Point Finance, LLC as administrative agent. The amendment reduces the rate to SOFR + 5.00% from SOFR + 5.75%, extends maturity to December 31, 2030 from January 12, 2030, defers amortization until June 30, 2028, requires TETRA Bromine Project LLC to guarantee, and adjusts covenant baskets. This is a routine debt amendment, not a special situation; no equity terms, premiums, or deal mechanics apply.
